about_the_game:
Croak Squad is a cooperative puzzle game that supports 2–6 players online, featuring a total of 23 levels.

Players take on the role of a simple and cute frog, using the unique swallow-and-spit mechanic to work together and clear stages.

As the game progresses, the difficulty gradually increases, introducing new combinations of mechanisms that require players to coordinate their actions and timing with teammates to overcome various challenges.

  • Default Controls:

    A: Move left

    D: Move right

    Left Mouse Button: Swallow

    Right Mouse Button: Spit

    (Aiming direction is based on your mouse cursor)

  • 🤝 Online Co-op for 2–6 Players

    The full experience is playable with just 2 people—but it’s even more fun when more friends join in to cause some chaos together!

  • 🐸 Swallow-and-Spit Teammate Mechanic

    Swallow your teammate whole… then spit them out to reach new places (or into trouble)!

  • 🧠 Puzzle-Based Level Design

    Solve challenges by using parabolic angles and smart teamwork.

    Don’t forget to communicate with your teammates!

  • 🎨 Minimalist Style + Cute Characters

    Clean visuals with low saturation—easy on the eyes and pleasant to look at.

  • 🚪 Progressive Level Challenges

    From relaxed sliding stages to friendship-breaking co-op puzzles—

    watch out for the mischievous troublemaker on your team!

  • Come enjoy a fun-filled, chaotic adventure with your friends!

short_description: Croak Squad is a 2–6 player co-op game where colorful frogs use their tongues to swallow teammates and spit them in arcs to clear trap-filled stages. Sounds easy? Later levels demand perfect timing and launch angles—sometimes even yeeting friends straight to the goal!
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Russian, Japanese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
